method: Non-merge commits and changed implementation files inspected. Real-name/alias mappings confirmed by the portfolio owner; GitHub account logins verified from public commit metadata. Roles summarize historical contributions, not exclusive ownership of current modules.

members.name: Tianyu Ma
members.contribution: Delaunay/Kruskal generation; key, chest and monster interactions; discovery-aware traversal and Efficient GoalAI; danger costs and bounded supply detours; eight-direction movement and animation/corner fixes. Extended the team framework, original fog and GoalAI foundations.

members.name: Jinghao Zheng
members.contribution: Initial grid/model and generator framework, VContainer setup, tilemap rendering and player pipeline; RuleTile configuration and minimap foundation; asset and animation integration. The repository credits original artwork to SaltyfishAlpha; third-party assets retain their own notices.

members.name: Changfeng Wang
members.contribution: Random and Metroidvania generators; animated map generation and BFS/DFS room traversal; original visual fog, player health and exit/level progression; GoalAI foundation, difficulty scaling, hazards, coins and scoring; later key-placement safeguards.

members.name: Monica Kumaran
members.contribution: RoomsWithCorridors weighted graph generation and PrimMSTGenerator; MST line visualization; subsequent graph connectivity, edge handling and visualization corrections. Credits describe committed implementation and iteration, without claiming every layout was acyclic or bug-free.
